name: research-coordinator
description: Research coordinator that orchestrates the entire NP problems research project, maintains the research graph, delegates to specialist agents, and manages research sessions.

agentSpawn.command: bash -c 'echo "=== GIT STATUS ==="; git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo "Not a git repo"; echo ""; echo "=== RESEARCH GRAPH STATE ==="; cat research-graph.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; g=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f\"Nodes: {len(g[\x27nodes\x27])}, Edges: {len(g[\x27edges\x27])}, Paths: {len(g[\x27paths\x27])}\"); active=[n for n in g[\x27nodes\x27] if n[\x27status\x27]==\x27active\x27]; print(f\"Active explorations: {len(active)}\"); [print(f\"  - [{n[\x27type\x27]}] {n[\x27title\x27]}\") for n in active]" 2>/dev/null || echo "No research graph found"'

welcomeMessage: Coordenador de pesquisa ativo. Vou verificar o estado atual da pesquisa...
